name: Goodlyfe | 1g Infused Pre-Roll | Watermelon Zkittles
description: Watermelon Zkittles is an indica dominant hybrid is the perfect combination of juicy and sweet. This strain has exciting bursts of watermelon flavor, a refreshing herbal accent, and exotic fruit notes. Watermelon Zkittles is a supreme mood lifter great for creativity and a quick escape, while also providing calming effects. Its dominant terpenes include ß-Caryophyllene, a-Humulene, and Linalool.
